AccountChangeRequest.description: A new role, or whether the account is disabled; at least one.
AccountChangeRequest.title: AccountChangeRequest

AuditEntryResponse.description:
An admin action: when, who acted, what they did, on whose account where it names one, and
the rest of what changed.
AuditEntryResponse.title: AuditEntryResponse

CorporateActionResponse.description:
An action with its terms as an announcement states them, the factor it applies to earlier
prices or the dividend in rupees a share, the venue's own text where its terms are unknown, who
reported it, whether the two venues' records differ, whether its factor is applied, and the
source of the record shown, absent for a fund's unit split read from the prices.
CorporateActionResponse.title: CorporateActionResponse

InstrumentMatchResponse.description:
An instrument a search found, under the ISIN it trades under now, with the symbol a reader
knows it by and the venues it is listed at now.
InstrumentMatchResponse.title: InstrumentMatchResponse

InstrumentResponse.title: InstrumentResponse

IssuedPasswordResponse.description: The account, and the temporary password just issued for it, shown this once.
IssuedPasswordResponse.title: IssuedPasswordResponse

KeyFiguresResponse.description:
The instrument's newest day at the venue up to the published day: the day as traded, its
change and return on the adjusted series, its delivery share, the spread to the other venue and
whether it diverged, the venue's verdict on the day, whether the day is older than the published
one, and the sources read. Every figure is absent where the instrument never traded there.
KeyFiguresResponse.title: KeyFiguresResponse

MarketDayResponse.description:
The day the market pages show; every field absent before the first publish of the daily
features.
MarketDayResponse.title: MarketDayResponse

PersonResponse.description:
An account: who holds it, their role, whether it is disabled or awaits a chosen password,
when it was added and when its holder last signed in.
PersonResponse.title: PersonResponse

PriceDayResponse.description:
A trading day at the venue: the candle, volume and delivery adjusted for every later action,
the close as traded with the factor between the two, the other venue's adjusted close, the
spread and whether it diverged, and the overlays in the candle's scale, absent on a day whose
daily features were computed on the other venue.
PriceDayResponse.title: PriceDayResponse

PriceHistoryResponse.description:
The days of the range at the venue, ending on the instrument's newest day there up to the
published day; a replaced ISIN's own days alone.
PriceHistoryResponse.title: PriceHistoryResponse

SessionEnded.description: Why the request's session is not running; every field absent where it never was.
SessionEnded.title: SessionEnded

SessionLimitsChangeRequest.description: A new idle limit, a new maximum, or both.
SessionLimitsChangeRequest.title: SessionLimitsChangeRequest

SessionLimitsResponse.description: Minutes a session may go unused, hours it may last at most, and when either last changed.
SessionLimitsResponse.title: SessionLimitsResponse

SignInRefused.description: Why a sign-in was refused, and until when where it is paused.
SignInRefused.title: SignInRefused

SourceResponse.description: A source figures are read from, with its trust tier and the SEBI curation row naming it.
SourceResponse.title: SourceResponse

get.description: The newest admin actions, newest first.
The session limits in force for everyone.

patch.description: Set the idle limit, the maximum, or both; running sessions are held to them at once.

post.description: Add a person, with a temporary password they replace at first sign-in.

patch.description: Change an account's role or whether it is disabled.

post.description: Replace an account's password with a temporary one, ending its sessions.
Replace the temporary password an admin set with one the person chooses.

get.description:
Up to ten instruments whose name holds the text, or whose symbol or ISIN starts with it, or
whose scrip code is it; instruments listed now first.
The instrument's corporate actions up to the published day, newest first.
The instrument's newest day at the venue, as its key figures show it.
The instrument's daily series at the venue over the range, as its price chart draws it.

The day the market pages show, each venue's verdict on it, and the latest day up to it
complete at every venue in session.
